title: Aircraft Materials | Cleaning and Protecting Oils

questions.question: Which substance cleans acrylics and rubber?
questions.explanation: Aliphatic naphtha cleans acrylics and rubber.

questions.question: What protects the interior surface of structural steel tubing?
questions.explanation: Linseed oil protects the interior surface of structural steel tubing.

questions.question: Which substance is used for nickel-cadmium batteries?
questions.explanation: Boric acid is used for nickel-cadmium batteries.
